references.text: Psalm 37:21 speaks of the wicked who borrow and do not repay, which mirrors the attitude of the servant who demands what is owed to him.
In Matthew 6:12-15 we are urged to forgive our debtors, which stands in contrast to the actions of the servant in Matthew 18:28.
Luke 7:41-43 presents a parable about forgiving debts, which can be seen as parallel to the story of the servant who refused to forgive his fellow servant.
James 2:13 speaks of the law of mercy that triumphs over judgment, reflecting the criticism of the servant's lack of mercy in Matthew 18:28.
